title: Approximation Paving over Arbitrary Maximal Abelian Subalgebras
main_claim: Theorem 1.1 says that for every MASA A in a von Neumann algebra M, every self-adjoint x and every 0<eps<1, there are y=y* with ||y||<=3||x|| that are strongly close to x on any finite set of test vectors, a partition of unity in A with R(eps)<=C eps^-6 members, and a=a* in A with ||a||<=||y||, such that ||C_P(y)-a|| <= eps||y||. This proves the approximation-paving half of the Popa–Vaes conjecture, with no separability or expectation hypothesis.

issues.location: general.tex, proofs of Corollary 1.2 (so-paving) and Corollary 1.3 (quadratic expected approximation)
issues.description: Both corollaries convert between paving notions using PV15 Proposition 2.4(1)/(2), with specific constants (eps/12, eps'=eps/6, error 2*3*eps'). Corollary 1.3 also depends on the companion paper OAQuadratic26 Theorem 1.1. These steps cannot be checked from this source alone. The main theorem bounds the error relative to ||y|| and gives ||a||<=||y||. Whether that matches the normalization in PV15 Definition 2.3 (which may be relative to ||x||) is asserted, not shown. Theorem 1.1 itself does not depend on these corollaries.
issues.evidence: "every such x is (eps/12,R(eps/12);3)-approximately pavable ... Apply [PV15, Proposition 2.4(1)] with eps'=eps/6. Its error is 2*3*(eps/6)=eps"

coverage: I read everything except the Maharam figure and the bibliography. In the final assembly (general.tex) I checked: the three-corner construction, the bounds ||y-x||<=2 and ||y||<=3, the test-vector control via xi_0, the clipping step, and the parameter count R=(r+1)^2 n+m+1 ~ eps^-6. I also checked there the separable reduction (A_1 is a MASA in M_1), Lemma no-central-functional (random roots-of-unity labels, natural-cone overlaps, Powers–Stormer, spectral separation, sequential effects, cyclic average giving p_i s p_i <= p_i/m), and the support decomposition with the glued expectation. In expected.tex I checked: the constants gamma/4 + gamma/2, the normalizer lemma's common-refinement argument, the free-product dilation kernel formula (recomputed entrywise), the MASA claims, the moment and concentration argument in Lemma random-freeness (Haar compression, the return-probability identity sum_p phi(p K^m(p) p), Efron–Stein), Lemma free-compression (consistent with the exact free compression norm 2 sqrt(t(1-t))), and the quotient-norm transfer. I checked Lemma atomless (graph projection, polar intertwining, the type I algebra D, the Akemann–Sherman partition, h_j in the closure of A phi^{1/2}) and the atomic reduction. In polynomials.tex I checked the MSS-derived bound 2sqrt(2/r)+2/r and verified every constant in Lemma tail-control (6H*3700H^2/10H=2220H^2, 15/232H, 40/3) and in Lemma buffered-pin (both the large-m and small-m cases, the M_- control and the K thresholds). For pinning.tex (sparse update recurrence, iteration, deletion monotonicity, descent with |I_int|/L>=1/2) and slabs.tex (Maharam invariance, locality, far-deletion, coherent choice) I checked the logic step by step but did not re-derive every analytic estimate. I did not verify the cited external results themselves (MSS15 Thms 4.1/5.1, AS12 Thm 4.1, PV15 Prop 2.4, FM77, Takesaki).
